incident: Spoofed Breach Portal Harvests More Victims
description: [UPDATE 0:15] Acadia issued HIPAA breach notifications to all affected patients (A4, $1M), activated free credit monitoring and identity theft protection (A5, $500K), and established a dedicated patient support hotline with counselors (A6, $250K). Acadia consulted with CISA (Yosemite) on security assessment and coordinated with Zion (Faith Network) on identifying affected congregants. However, the fake portal itself has NOT been taken down and continues harvesting victims. No network-level blocking or platform takedown has been initiated for the fraudulent site. Hundreds more may have entered personal data since the inject began.

incident: Panic Buying Empties Shelves Across Region
description: [UPDATE 0:25] No teams have directly addressed the panic buying crisis. Shelves remain empty across 12 Food City locations. Fuel shortages worsening at Salem and Christiansburg stations. Redwood's Multilingual Alert System (A9) and Rumor Tracking (A21) are helping prevent NEW panic but cannot undo the damage already done. Food City (Yellowstone) addressed the attribution leak instead of supply chain stabilization.
